messages:
SRE Deploy Bot: deploy started for release v2.18.0 -> prod
Alex Chen: deploy-bot flagged a post-deploy parity check failure :rotating_light:
SRE Deploy Bot: parity check failed: schema mismatch between staging and prod for REDWOOD_SERVING_CONFIG
SRE Deploy Bot: staging has `model_variants` (array) but prod has `model_variant` (string)
Alex Chen: uh — that explains the runtime crash we saw in canary. logs show JSON parse error when reading MODEL_VARS
Sofia Patel: :eyes: is this from the config management move last week? the helm values template changed to allow array
Manu Krishnan: yes, #1173 changed to arrays for multi-variant routing. prod was never migrated because the migration job errored on KMS unwrap last Tuesday
Jamie Rivera: suggestion: rollback the image to v2.17.4 and pin until we reconcile configs. canary traffic currently 5% and errors are rising
Alex Chen: agree. rollout paused by deploy-bot? @SRE Deploy Bot status
SRE Deploy Bot: rollout paused by policy: post-deploy-check.failed -> holding at 0% progressive rollout
Oncall Bot: paging @Jamie Rivera and @Alex Chen — incident channel AD-HOC created: /incidents/INC-2026-042
Jamie Rivera: creating quick rollback PR to pin image tag and set environment to the previous schema: repo infra/helm release override -> image:v2.17.4
Sofia Patel: also we should add a migration job to sync prod -> run the helm post-upgrade hook that converts `model_variant` -> `model_variants` array. I'll open a runbook entry
Manu Krishnan: live mitigation: add a compatibility parser in runtime that accepts both fields for next 48h. small patch, then run migration
Alex Chen: priority: rollback first to stop user impact, then deploy compatibility patch to staging+canary, then run migration in prod during change window
Jamie Rivera: rollback PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/542
Jamie Rivera: will schedule a controlled rollout tomorrow 03/21 02:00 UTC (change window) for the migration and patch
Sofia Patel: adding release notes entry and postmortem stub. also tagging the config-mgmt team
Alex Chen: creating ticket to add an env-parity gate in our release pipeline: verify helm schema keys exist in both clusters before allowing rollout. ticket: RED-3201
Manu Krishnan: also adding a KMS unwrap retry and alert so migration jobs don't silently fail next time
Oncall Bot: rollback initiated by @Jamie Rivera at 1798501258
SRE Deploy Bot: rollback completed, image pinned to v2.17.4 in prod. health checks green.
Alex Chen: leaving follow-ups:
- RED-3201: pre-deploy env-parity gate
- INFRA-1219: migration job robustness and KMS unwrap retries
- RUNTIME-782: compatibility parser for legacy config
Jamie Rivera: closing thread once CI passes on the rollback PR. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: CI passed, rollback merged. I'll post the brief to release-notes and incident channel in a minute.
